feeding_claim.verbatim: After grazing on pasture, our grain-finished cattle enjoy a 90-day finishing process where we feed daily from locally-sourced grains.

availability.note: Both beef share products marked sold out in the online store.

notes: Angus beef sold as quarter, half and whole shares in two lines: Grass Fed, Grass Finished and Grass Fed, Grain Finished, so category both. The quoted sentence was returned in two pieces by the fetch tool; Verifier should confirm exact wording.
